															Delhi Police Driver Exam Pattern 2025: Written Test & Trade Test

															The Delhi Police Driver recruitment process includes a Written Exam (CBT) and a mandatory Trade Test.

															A. Written Exam Pattern (CBT)

															
																
																The exam is a computer-based, objective-type test consisting of a total of 100 questions for 100 marks.
																
																
																The time duration for the entire test is 90 minutes.
																
																
																There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer.
																
																
																The subject related to Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules carries the highest weightage with 50 questions (50 marks).
																
																
																General Awareness/GK and General Intelligence each contribute 20 questions (20 marks), while Numerical Ability contributes 10 questions (10 marks).
																
															

															 

															B. Trade Test Pattern

															
																
																The Trade Test is qualifying in nature and totals 125 marks; these marks do not determine the final merit position.
																
																
																Driving Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) is tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Driving Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) is also tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Knowledge of Traffic Signs/Road Sense/Basic Driving Rules is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), including topics like Lane Driving, Overtaking Procedure, and Road Map Reading.
																
																
																Knowledge of Vehicle Maintenance is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), covering practical aspects like tire pressure, battery level, oil usage, coolant, and belt/hose tension.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Delhi Police Constable Driver Syllabus 2025: Exam Details and Key Topics

															Preparing for the Delhi Police Constable Driver 2025 exam? Get a competitive edge by reviewing the complete syllabus for the Computer-Based Examination. The test covers essential subjects including General Awareness/GK, General Intelligence, Numerical Ability, and a specialized section on Subject Related topics like Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules.

															 

															Key Subjects and Topics to Study:

															1. General Awareness / GK (General Knowledge)

															This section tests your knowledge of current events and significant matters related to India and its neighboring countries. Essential topics for your GK preparation include:

															
																
																Sports, History, Culture,  Geography, Indian Economy, General Polity, Indian Constitution, Scientific Research
																
															

															 

															2. General Intelligence / Reasoning

															The General Intelligence and Reasoning section evaluates your analytical aptitude and ability to identify patterns. Focus on mastering both verbal and non-verbal types of questions:

															
																
																Analogies, Similarities and Differences, Spatial Visualization, Spatial Orientation, Visual Memory, Discrimination, Observation, Relationship Concepts, Arithmetical Reasoning and Figural Classification, Arithmetic Number Series, Non-Verbal Series & Coding and Decoding
																
															

															 

															3. Numerical Ability (Quantitative Aptitude)

															This subject covers problems related to fundamental mathematical concepts. Strong preparation in these areas is crucial for scoring well:

															
																
																Number System,  Computation of Whole Numbers, Decimals and Fractions,  Relationship between Numbers, Fundamental Arithmetical Operations,  Percentages, Ratio and Proportion, Averages, Interest (Simple and Compound), Profit and Loss,  Discount,  Mensuration, Time and Distance, Ratio and Time, Time and Work.
																
															

															 

															4. Subject Related (Driver Specific Knowledge)

															This specialized section is vital for the Constable Driver post and includes technical and regulatory knowledge:

															
																
																Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, Traffic Rules/Signals/Signages, Vehicle & Environmental Pollution (including I.e., Petrol and Diesel Vehicle, CNG operated Vehicle) Noise Pollution
																
															
															
														
													
															
															Delhi Police Driver Recruitment 2025 – Salary, Admit Card, Answer Key, Result

															Delhi Police Driver Salary 2025

															The Delhi Police Driver Salary 2025 falls under the Level 3 pay scale with a salary range of ₹21700 – ₹69100/- plus Grade Pay ₹2000. The pay structure is as per the 7th Pay Commission. Along with the basic pay, selected candidates will receive Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Travelling Allowance (TA), and Ration Pay provided by the Government.

															Delhi Police Driver Admit Card 2025

															The Delhi Police Driver Admit Card 2025 will be released 15 days before the exam date. As per the SSC Exam Calendar 2025, the written test for Delhi Police Constable Driver Recruitment 2025 will be conducted in November–December 2025. Candidates can download their admit card from the official SSC regional websites.

															Delhi Police Driver Answer Key 2025

															The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) will release the Delhi Police Driver Answer Key 2025 for the Computer-Based Test (CBT) within 15 days after the exam. First, a provisional answer key will be published, followed by the final answer key on the official SSC website. Candidates can check and raise objections (if any) before the final release.

															Delhi Police Driver Result 2025

															The Delhi Police Driver Result 2025 will be declared once the exam is successfully conducted. Candidates can check their results by roll number and name on the official SSC portal – ssc.gov.in.

															
																
																Those who qualify the cut-off marks will be eligible for the next stage of recruitment.
																
																
																After the Physical Endurance & Measurement Test (PEMT), the final merit list will be published on the official website.
																
																
																Selection will be based on written exam, PEMT, medical tests, and overall merit.

															Delhi Police Driver Exam Pattern 2025: Written Test & Trade Test

															The Delhi Police Driver recruitment process includes a Written Exam (CBT) and a mandatory Trade Test.

															A. Written Exam Pattern (CBT)

															
																
																The exam is a computer-based, objective-type test consisting of a total of 100 questions for 100 marks.
																
																
																The time duration for the entire test is 90 minutes.
																
																
																There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer.
																
																
																The subject related to Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules carries the highest weightage with 50 questions (50 marks).
																
																
																General Awareness/GK and General Intelligence each contribute 20 questions (20 marks), while Numerical Ability contributes 10 questions (10 marks).
																
															

															 

															B. Trade Test Pattern

															
																
																The Trade Test is qualifying in nature and totals 125 marks; these marks do not determine the final merit position.
																
																
																Driving Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) is tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Driving Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) is also tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Knowledge of Traffic Signs/Road Sense/Basic Driving Rules is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), including topics like Lane Driving, Overtaking Procedure, and Road Map Reading.
																
																
																Knowledge of Vehicle Maintenance is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), covering practical aspects like tire pressure, battery level, oil usage, coolant, and belt/hose tension.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Delhi Police Constable Driver Syllabus 2025: Exam Details and Key Topics

															Preparing for the Delhi Police Constable Driver 2025 exam? Get a competitive edge by reviewing the complete syllabus for the Computer-Based Examination. The test covers essential subjects including General Awareness/GK, General Intelligence, Numerical Ability, and a specialized section on Subject Related topics like Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules.

															 

															Key Subjects and Topics to Study:

															1. General Awareness / GK (General Knowledge)

															This section tests your knowledge of current events and significant matters related to India and its neighboring countries. Essential topics for your GK preparation include:

															
																
																Sports, History, Culture,  Geography, Indian Economy, General Polity, Indian Constitution, Scientific Research
																
															

															 

															2. General Intelligence / Reasoning

															The General Intelligence and Reasoning section evaluates your analytical aptitude and ability to identify patterns. Focus on mastering both verbal and non-verbal types of questions:

															
																
																Analogies, Similarities and Differences, Spatial Visualization, Spatial Orientation, Visual Memory, Discrimination, Observation, Relationship Concepts, Arithmetical Reasoning and Figural Classification, Arithmetic Number Series, Non-Verbal Series & Coding and Decoding
																
															

															 

															3. Numerical Ability (Quantitative Aptitude)

															This subject covers problems related to fundamental mathematical concepts. Strong preparation in these areas is crucial for scoring well:

															
																
																Number System,  Computation of Whole Numbers, Decimals and Fractions,  Relationship between Numbers, Fundamental Arithmetical Operations,  Percentages, Ratio and Proportion, Averages, Interest (Simple and Compound), Profit and Loss,  Discount,  Mensuration, Time and Distance, Ratio and Time, Time and Work.
																
															

															 

															4. Subject Related (Driver Specific Knowledge)

															This specialized section is vital for the Constable Driver post and includes technical and regulatory knowledge:

															
																
																Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, Traffic Rules/Signals/Signages, Vehicle & Environmental Pollution (including I.e., Petrol and Diesel Vehicle, CNG operated Vehicle) Noise Pollution

															Delhi Police Driver Exam Pattern 2025: Written Test & Trade Test

															The Delhi Police Driver recruitment process includes a Written Exam (CBT) and a mandatory Trade Test.

															A. Written Exam Pattern (CBT)

															
																
																The exam is a computer-based, objective-type test consisting of a total of 100 questions for 100 marks.
																
																
																The time duration for the entire test is 90 minutes.
																
																
																There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer.
																
																
																The subject related to Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules carries the highest weightage with 50 questions (50 marks).
																
																
																General Awareness/GK and General Intelligence each contribute 20 questions (20 marks), while Numerical Ability contributes 10 questions (10 marks).
																
															

															 

															B. Trade Test Pattern

															
																
																The Trade Test is qualifying in nature and totals 125 marks; these marks do not determine the final merit position.
																
																
																Driving Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) is tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Driving Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) is also tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Knowledge of Traffic Signs/Road Sense/Basic Driving Rules is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), including topics like Lane Driving, Overtaking Procedure, and Road Map Reading.
																
																
																Knowledge of Vehicle Maintenance is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), covering practical aspects like tire pressure, battery level, oil usage, coolant, and belt/hose tension.

															Delhi Police Driver Exam Pattern 2025: Written Test & Trade Test

															The Delhi Police Driver recruitment process includes a Written Exam (CBT) and a mandatory Trade Test.

															A. Written Exam Pattern (CBT)

															
																
																The exam is a computer-based, objective-type test consisting of a total of 100 questions for 100 marks.
																
																
																The time duration for the entire test is 90 minutes.
																
																
																There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer.
																
																
																The subject related to Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules carries the highest weightage with 50 questions (50 marks).
																
																
																General Awareness/GK and General Intelligence each contribute 20 questions (20 marks), while Numerical Ability contributes 10 questions (10 marks).
																
															

															 

															B. Trade Test Pattern

															
																
																The Trade Test is qualifying in nature and totals 125 marks; these marks do not determine the final merit position.
																
																
																Driving Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) is tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Driving Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) is also tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Knowledge of Traffic Signs/Road Sense/Basic Driving Rules is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), including topics like Lane Driving, Overtaking Procedure, and Road Map Reading.
																
																
																Knowledge of Vehicle Maintenance is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), covering practical aspects like tire pressure, battery level, oil usage, coolant, and belt/hose tension.

															Delhi Police Driver Exam Pattern 2025: Written Test & Trade Test

															The Delhi Police Driver recruitment process includes a Written Exam (CBT) and a mandatory Trade Test.

															A. Written Exam Pattern (CBT)

															
																
																The exam is a computer-based, objective-type test consisting of a total of 100 questions for 100 marks.
																
																
																The time duration for the entire test is 90 minutes.
																
																
																There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer.
																
																
																The subject related to Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules carries the highest weightage with 50 questions (50 marks).
																
																
																General Awareness/GK and General Intelligence each contribute 20 questions (20 marks), while Numerical Ability contributes 10 questions (10 marks).
																
															

															 

															B. Trade Test Pattern

															
																
																The Trade Test is qualifying in nature and totals 125 marks; these marks do not determine the final merit position.
																
																
																Driving Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) is tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Driving Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) is also tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Knowledge of Traffic Signs/Road Sense/Basic Driving Rules is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), including topics like Lane Driving, Overtaking Procedure, and Road Map Reading.
																
																
																Knowledge of Vehicle Maintenance is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), covering practical aspects like tire pressure, battery level, oil usage, coolant, and belt/hose tension.

															Delhi Police Driver Exam Pattern 2025: Written Test & Trade Test

															The Delhi Police Driver recruitment process includes a Written Exam (CBT) and a mandatory Trade Test.

															A. Written Exam Pattern (CBT)

															
																
																The exam is a computer-based, objective-type test consisting of a total of 100 questions for 100 marks.
																
																
																The time duration for the entire test is 90 minutes.
																
																
																There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer.
																
																
																The subject related to Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules carries the highest weightage with 50 questions (50 marks).
																
																
																General Awareness/GK and General Intelligence each contribute 20 questions (20 marks), while Numerical Ability contributes 10 questions (10 marks).
																
															

															 

															B. Trade Test Pattern

															
																
																The Trade Test is qualifying in nature and totals 125 marks; these marks do not determine the final merit position.
																
																
																Driving Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) is tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Driving Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) is also tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Knowledge of Traffic Signs/Road Sense/Basic Driving Rules is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), including topics like Lane Driving, Overtaking Procedure, and Road Map Reading.
																
																
																Knowledge of Vehicle Maintenance is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), covering practical aspects like tire pressure, battery level, oil usage, coolant, and belt/hose tension.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Delhi Police Constable Driver Syllabus 2025: Exam Details and Key Topics

															Preparing for the Delhi Police Constable Driver 2025 exam? Get a competitive edge by reviewing the complete syllabus for the Computer-Based Examination. The test covers essential subjects including General Awareness/GK, General Intelligence, Numerical Ability, and a specialized section on Subject Related topics like Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules.

															 

															Key Subjects and Topics to Study:

															1. General Awareness / GK (General Knowledge)

															This section tests your knowledge of current events and significant matters related to India and its neighboring countries. Essential topics for your GK preparation include:

															
																
																Sports, History, Culture,  Geography, Indian Economy, General Polity, Indian Constitution, Scientific Research
																
															

															 

															2. General Intelligence / Reasoning

															The General Intelligence and Reasoning section evaluates your analytical aptitude and ability to identify patterns. Focus on mastering both verbal and non-verbal types of questions:

															
																
																Analogies, Similarities and Differences, Spatial Visualization, Spatial Orientation, Visual Memory, Discrimination, Observation, Relationship Concepts, Arithmetical Reasoning and Figural Classification, Arithmetic Number Series, Non-Verbal Series & Coding and Decoding
																
															

															 

															3. Numerical Ability (Quantitative Aptitude)

															This subject covers problems related to fundamental mathematical concepts. Strong preparation in these areas is crucial for scoring well:

															
																
																Number System,  Computation of Whole Numbers, Decimals and Fractions,  Relationship between Numbers, Fundamental Arithmetical Operations,  Percentages, Ratio and Proportion, Averages, Interest (Simple and Compound), Profit and Loss,  Discount,  Mensuration, Time and Distance, Ratio and Time, Time and Work.
																
															

															 

															4. Subject Related (Driver Specific Knowledge)

															This specialized section is vital for the Constable Driver post and includes technical and regulatory knowledge:

															
																
																Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, Traffic Rules/Signals/Signages, Vehicle & Environmental Pollution (including I.e., Petrol and Diesel Vehicle, CNG operated Vehicle) Noise Pollution

															Delhi Police Driver Exam Pattern 2025: Written Test & Trade Test

															The Delhi Police Driver recruitment process includes a Written Exam (CBT) and a mandatory Trade Test.

															A. Written Exam Pattern (CBT)

															
																
																The exam is a computer-based, objective-type test consisting of a total of 100 questions for 100 marks.
																
																
																The time duration for the entire test is 90 minutes.
																
																
																There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer.
																
																
																The subject related to Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules carries the highest weightage with 50 questions (50 marks).
																
																
																General Awareness/GK and General Intelligence each contribute 20 questions (20 marks), while Numerical Ability contributes 10 questions (10 marks).
																
															

															 

															B. Trade Test Pattern

															
																
																The Trade Test is qualifying in nature and totals 125 marks; these marks do not determine the final merit position.
																
																
																Driving Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) is tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Driving Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) is also tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Knowledge of Traffic Signs/Road Sense/Basic Driving Rules is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), including topics like Lane Driving, Overtaking Procedure, and Road Map Reading.
																
																
																Knowledge of Vehicle Maintenance is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), covering practical aspects like tire pressure, battery level, oil usage, coolant, and belt/hose tension.

															Delhi Police Driver Exam Pattern 2025: Written Test & Trade Test

															The Delhi Police Driver recruitment process includes a Written Exam (CBT) and a mandatory Trade Test.

															A. Written Exam Pattern (CBT)

															
																
																The exam is a computer-based, objective-type test consisting of a total of 100 questions for 100 marks.
																
																
																The time duration for the entire test is 90 minutes.
																
																
																There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer.
																
																
																The subject related to Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules carries the highest weightage with 50 questions (50 marks).
																
																
																General Awareness/GK and General Intelligence each contribute 20 questions (20 marks), while Numerical Ability contributes 10 questions (10 marks).
																
															

															 

															B. Trade Test Pattern

															
																
																The Trade Test is qualifying in nature and totals 125 marks; these marks do not determine the final merit position.
																
																
																Driving Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) is tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Driving Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) is also tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Knowledge of Traffic Signs/Road Sense/Basic Driving Rules is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), including topics like Lane Driving, Overtaking Procedure, and Road Map Reading.
																
																
																Knowledge of Vehicle Maintenance is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), covering practical aspects like tire pressure, battery level, oil usage, coolant, and belt/hose tension.

															Delhi Police Driver Exam Pattern 2025: Written Test & Trade Test

															The Delhi Police Driver recruitment process includes a Written Exam (CBT) and a mandatory Trade Test.

															A. Written Exam Pattern (CBT)

															
																
																The exam is a computer-based, objective-type test consisting of a total of 100 questions for 100 marks.
																
																
																The time duration for the entire test is 90 minutes.
																
																
																There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer.
																
																
																The subject related to Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules carries the highest weightage with 50 questions (50 marks).
																
																
																General Awareness/GK and General Intelligence each contribute 20 questions (20 marks), while Numerical Ability contributes 10 questions (10 marks).
																
															

															 

															B. Trade Test Pattern

															
																
																The Trade Test is qualifying in nature and totals 125 marks; these marks do not determine the final merit position.
																
																
																Driving Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) is tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Driving Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) is also tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Knowledge of Traffic Signs/Road Sense/Basic Driving Rules is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), including topics like Lane Driving, Overtaking Procedure, and Road Map Reading.
																
																
																Knowledge of Vehicle Maintenance is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), covering practical aspects like tire pressure, battery level, oil usage, coolant, and belt/hose tension.

															Delhi Police Driver Exam Pattern 2025: Written Test & Trade Test

															The Delhi Police Driver recruitment process includes a Written Exam (CBT) and a mandatory Trade Test.

															A. Written Exam Pattern (CBT)

															
																
																The exam is a computer-based, objective-type test consisting of a total of 100 questions for 100 marks.
																
																
																The time duration for the entire test is 90 minutes.
																
																
																There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer.
																
																
																The subject related to Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules carries the highest weightage with 50 questions (50 marks).
																
																
																General Awareness/GK and General Intelligence each contribute 20 questions (20 marks), while Numerical Ability contributes 10 questions (10 marks).
																
															

															 

															B. Trade Test Pattern

															
																
																The Trade Test is qualifying in nature and totals 125 marks; these marks do not determine the final merit position.
																
																
																Driving Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) is tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Driving Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) is also tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Knowledge of Traffic Signs/Road Sense/Basic Driving Rules is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), including topics like Lane Driving, Overtaking Procedure, and Road Map Reading.
																
																
																Knowledge of Vehicle Maintenance is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), covering practical aspects like tire pressure, battery level, oil usage, coolant, and belt/hose tension.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Delhi Police Constable Driver Syllabus 2025: Exam Details and Key Topics

															Preparing for the Delhi Police Constable Driver 2025 exam? Get a competitive edge by reviewing the complete syllabus for the Computer-Based Examination. The test covers essential subjects including General Awareness/GK, General Intelligence, Numerical Ability, and a specialized section on Subject Related topics like Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules.

															 

															Key Subjects and Topics to Study:

															1. General Awareness / GK (General Knowledge)

															This section tests your knowledge of current events and significant matters related to India and its neighboring countries. Essential topics for your GK preparation include:

															
																
																Sports, History, Culture,  Geography, Indian Economy, General Polity, Indian Constitution, Scientific Research
																
															

															 

															2. General Intelligence / Reasoning

															The General Intelligence and Reasoning section evaluates your analytical aptitude and ability to identify patterns. Focus on mastering both verbal and non-verbal types of questions:

															
																
																Analogies, Similarities and Differences, Spatial Visualization, Spatial Orientation, Visual Memory, Discrimination, Observation, Relationship Concepts, Arithmetical Reasoning and Figural Classification, Arithmetic Number Series, Non-Verbal Series & Coding and Decoding
																
															

															 

															3. Numerical Ability (Quantitative Aptitude)

															This subject covers problems related to fundamental mathematical concepts. Strong preparation in these areas is crucial for scoring well:

															
																
																Number System,  Computation of Whole Numbers, Decimals and Fractions,  Relationship between Numbers, Fundamental Arithmetical Operations,  Percentages, Ratio and Proportion, Averages, Interest (Simple and Compound), Profit and Loss,  Discount,  Mensuration, Time and Distance, Ratio and Time, Time and Work.
																
															

															 

															4. Subject Related (Driver Specific Knowledge)

															This specialized section is vital for the Constable Driver post and includes technical and regulatory knowledge:

															
																
																Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, Traffic Rules/Signals/Signages, Vehicle & Environmental Pollution (including I.e., Petrol and Diesel Vehicle, CNG operated Vehicle) Noise Pollution

															Delhi Police Driver Exam Pattern 2025: Written Test & Trade Test

															The Delhi Police Driver recruitment process includes a Written Exam (CBT) and a mandatory Trade Test.

															A. Written Exam Pattern (CBT)

															
																
																The exam is a computer-based, objective-type test consisting of a total of 100 questions for 100 marks.
																
																
																The time duration for the entire test is 90 minutes.
																
																
																There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer.
																
																
																The subject related to Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules carries the highest weightage with 50 questions (50 marks).
																
																
																General Awareness/GK and General Intelligence each contribute 20 questions (20 marks), while Numerical Ability contributes 10 questions (10 marks).
																
															

															 

															B. Trade Test Pattern

															
																
																The Trade Test is qualifying in nature and totals 125 marks; these marks do not determine the final merit position.
																
																
																Driving Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) is tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Driving Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) is also tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Knowledge of Traffic Signs/Road Sense/Basic Driving Rules is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), including topics like Lane Driving, Overtaking Procedure, and Road Map Reading.
																
																
																Knowledge of Vehicle Maintenance is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), covering practical aspects like tire pressure, battery level, oil usage, coolant, and belt/hose tension.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Delhi Police Constable Driver Syllabus 2025: Exam Details and Key Topics

															Preparing for the Delhi Police Constable Driver 2025 exam? Get a competitive edge by reviewing the complete syllabus for the Computer-Based Examination. The test covers essential subjects including General Awareness/GK, General Intelligence, Numerical Ability, and a specialized section on Subject Related topics like Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules.

															 

															Key Subjects and Topics to Study:

															1. General Awareness / GK (General Knowledge)

															This section tests your knowledge of current events and significant matters related to India and its neighboring countries. Essential topics for your GK preparation include:

															
																
																Sports, History, Culture,  Geography, Indian Economy, General Polity, Indian Constitution, Scientific Research
																
															

															 

															2. General Intelligence / Reasoning

															The General Intelligence and Reasoning section evaluates your analytical aptitude and ability to identify patterns. Focus on mastering both verbal and non-verbal types of questions:

															
																
																Analogies, Similarities and Differences, Spatial Visualization, Spatial Orientation, Visual Memory, Discrimination, Observation, Relationship Concepts, Arithmetical Reasoning and Figural Classification, Arithmetic Number Series, Non-Verbal Series & Coding and Decoding
																
															

															 

															3. Numerical Ability (Quantitative Aptitude)

															This subject covers problems related to fundamental mathematical concepts. Strong preparation in these areas is crucial for scoring well:

															
																
																Number System,  Computation of Whole Numbers, Decimals and Fractions,  Relationship between Numbers, Fundamental Arithmetical Operations,  Percentages, Ratio and Proportion, Averages, Interest (Simple and Compound), Profit and Loss,  Discount,  Mensuration, Time and Distance, Ratio and Time, Time and Work.
																
															

															 

															4. Subject Related (Driver Specific Knowledge)

															This specialized section is vital for the Constable Driver post and includes technical and regulatory knowledge:

															
																
																Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, Traffic Rules/Signals/Signages, Vehicle & Environmental Pollution (including I.e., Petrol and Diesel Vehicle, CNG operated Vehicle) Noise Pollution

															Delhi Police Driver Exam Pattern 2025: Written Test & Trade Test

															The Delhi Police Driver recruitment process includes a Written Exam (CBT) and a mandatory Trade Test.

															A. Written Exam Pattern (CBT)

															
																
																The exam is a computer-based, objective-type test consisting of a total of 100 questions for 100 marks.
																
																
																The time duration for the entire test is 90 minutes.
																
																
																There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer.
																
																
																The subject related to Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules carries the highest weightage with 50 questions (50 marks).
																
																
																General Awareness/GK and General Intelligence each contribute 20 questions (20 marks), while Numerical Ability contributes 10 questions (10 marks).
																
															

															 

															B. Trade Test Pattern

															
																
																The Trade Test is qualifying in nature and totals 125 marks; these marks do not determine the final merit position.
																
																
																Driving Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) is tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Driving Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) is also tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Knowledge of Traffic Signs/Road Sense/Basic Driving Rules is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), including topics like Lane Driving, Overtaking Procedure, and Road Map Reading.
																
																
																Knowledge of Vehicle Maintenance is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), covering practical aspects like tire pressure, battery level, oil usage, coolant, and belt/hose tension.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Delhi Police Constable Driver Syllabus 2025: Exam Details and Key Topics

															Preparing for the Delhi Police Constable Driver 2025 exam? Get a competitive edge by reviewing the complete syllabus for the Computer-Based Examination. The test covers essential subjects including General Awareness/GK, General Intelligence, Numerical Ability, and a specialized section on Subject Related topics like Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules.

															 

															Key Subjects and Topics to Study:

															1. General Awareness / GK (General Knowledge)

															This section tests your knowledge of current events and significant matters related to India and its neighboring countries. Essential topics for your GK preparation include:

															
																
																Sports, History, Culture,  Geography, Indian Economy, General Polity, Indian Constitution, Scientific Research
																
															

															 

															2. General Intelligence / Reasoning

															The General Intelligence and Reasoning section evaluates your analytical aptitude and ability to identify patterns. Focus on mastering both verbal and non-verbal types of questions:

															
																
																Analogies, Similarities and Differences, Spatial Visualization, Spatial Orientation, Visual Memory, Discrimination, Observation, Relationship Concepts, Arithmetical Reasoning and Figural Classification, Arithmetic Number Series, Non-Verbal Series & Coding and Decoding
																
															

															 

															3. Numerical Ability (Quantitative Aptitude)

															This subject covers problems related to fundamental mathematical concepts. Strong preparation in these areas is crucial for scoring well:

															
																
																Number System,  Computation of Whole Numbers, Decimals and Fractions,  Relationship between Numbers, Fundamental Arithmetical Operations,  Percentages, Ratio and Proportion, Averages, Interest (Simple and Compound), Profit and Loss,  Discount,  Mensuration, Time and Distance, Ratio and Time, Time and Work.
																
															

															 

															4. Subject Related (Driver Specific Knowledge)

															This specialized section is vital for the Constable Driver post and includes technical and regulatory knowledge:

															
																
																Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, Traffic Rules/Signals/Signages, Vehicle & Environmental Pollution (including I.e., Petrol and Diesel Vehicle, CNG operated Vehicle) Noise Pollution

															Delhi Police Driver Exam Pattern 2025: Written Test & Trade Test

															The Delhi Police Driver recruitment process includes a Written Exam (CBT) and a mandatory Trade Test.

															A. Written Exam Pattern (CBT)

															
																
																The exam is a computer-based, objective-type test consisting of a total of 100 questions for 100 marks.
																
																
																The time duration for the entire test is 90 minutes.
																
																
																There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer.
																
																
																The subject related to Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules carries the highest weightage with 50 questions (50 marks).
																
																
																General Awareness/GK and General Intelligence each contribute 20 questions (20 marks), while Numerical Ability contributes 10 questions (10 marks).
																
															

															 

															B. Trade Test Pattern

															
																
																The Trade Test is qualifying in nature and totals 125 marks; these marks do not determine the final merit position.
																
																
																Driving Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) is tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Driving Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) is also tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Knowledge of Traffic Signs/Road Sense/Basic Driving Rules is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), including topics like Lane Driving, Overtaking Procedure, and Road Map Reading.
																
																
																Knowledge of Vehicle Maintenance is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), covering practical aspects like tire pressure, battery level, oil usage, coolant, and belt/hose tension.

															Delhi Police Driver Exam Pattern 2025: Written Test & Trade Test

															The Delhi Police Driver recruitment process includes a Written Exam (CBT) and a mandatory Trade Test.

															A. Written Exam Pattern (CBT)

															
																
																The exam is a computer-based, objective-type test consisting of a total of 100 questions for 100 marks.
																
																
																The time duration for the entire test is 90 minutes.
																
																
																There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer.
																
																
																The subject related to Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules carries the highest weightage with 50 questions (50 marks).
																
																
																General Awareness/GK and General Intelligence each contribute 20 questions (20 marks), while Numerical Ability contributes 10 questions (10 marks).
																
															

															 

															B. Trade Test Pattern

															
																
																The Trade Test is qualifying in nature and totals 125 marks; these marks do not determine the final merit position.
																
																
																Driving Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) is tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Driving Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) is also tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Knowledge of Traffic Signs/Road Sense/Basic Driving Rules is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), including topics like Lane Driving, Overtaking Procedure, and Road Map Reading.
																
																
																Knowledge of Vehicle Maintenance is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), covering practical aspects like tire pressure, battery level, oil usage, coolant, and belt/hose tension.

																Analogies, Similarities and Differences, Spatial Visualization, Spatial Orientation, Visual Memory, Discrimination, Observation, Relationship Concepts, Arithmetical Reasoning and Figural Classification, Arithmetic Number Series, Non-Verbal Series & Coding and Decoding
																
															

															 

															3. Numerical Ability (Quantitative Aptitude)

															This subject covers problems related to fundamental mathematical concepts. Strong preparation in these areas is crucial for scoring well:

															
																
																Number System,  Computation of Whole Numbers, Decimals and Fractions,  Relationship between Numbers, Fundamental Arithmetical Operations,  Percentages, Ratio and Proportion, Averages, Interest (Simple and Compound), Profit and Loss,  Discount,  Mensuration, Time and Distance, Ratio and Time, Time and Work.
																
															

															 

															4. Subject Related (Driver Specific Knowledge)

															Delhi Police Driver Exam Pattern 2025: Written Test & Trade Test

															The Delhi Police Driver recruitment process includes a Written Exam (CBT) and a mandatory Trade Test.

															A. Written Exam Pattern (CBT)

															
																
																The exam is a computer-based, objective-type test consisting of a total of 100 questions for 100 marks.
																
																
																The time duration for the entire test is 90 minutes.
																
																
																There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer.
																
																
																The subject related to Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules carries the highest weightage with 50 questions (50 marks).
																
																
																General Awareness/GK and General Intelligence each contribute 20 questions (20 marks), while Numerical Ability contributes 10 questions (10 marks).
																
															

															 

															B. Trade Test Pattern

															
																
																The Trade Test is qualifying in nature and totals 125 marks; these marks do not determine the final merit position.
																
																
																Driving Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) is tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Driving Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) is also tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Knowledge of Traffic Signs/Road Sense/Basic Driving Rules is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), including topics like Lane Driving, Overtaking Procedure, and Road Map Reading.
																
																
																Knowledge of Vehicle Maintenance is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), covering practical aspects like tire pressure, battery level, oil usage, coolant, and belt/hose tension.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Delhi Police Constable Driver Syllabus 2025: Exam Details and Key Topics

															Preparing for the Delhi Police Constable Driver 2025 exam? Get a competitive edge by reviewing the complete syllabus for the Computer-Based Examination. The test covers essential subjects including General Awareness/GK, General Intelligence, Numerical Ability, and a specialized section on Subject Related topics like Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules.

															 

															Key Subjects and Topics to Study:

															1. General Awareness / GK (General Knowledge)

															This section tests your knowledge of current events and significant matters related to India and its neighboring countries. Essential topics for your GK preparation include:

															
																
																Sports, History, Culture,  Geography, Indian Economy, General Polity, Indian Constitution, Scientific Research
																
															

															 

															2. General Intelligence / Reasoning

															The General Intelligence and Reasoning section evaluates your analytical aptitude and ability to identify patterns. Focus on mastering both verbal and non-verbal types of questions:

															
																
																Analogies, Similarities and Differences, Spatial Visualization, Spatial Orientation, Visual Memory, Discrimination, Observation, Relationship Concepts, Arithmetical Reasoning and Figural Classification, Arithmetic Number Series, Non-Verbal Series & Coding and Decoding
																
															

															 

															3. Numerical Ability (Quantitative Aptitude)

															This subject covers problems related to fundamental mathematical concepts. Strong preparation in these areas is crucial for scoring well:

															
																
																Number System,  Computation of Whole Numbers, Decimals and Fractions,  Relationship between Numbers, Fundamental Arithmetical Operations,  Percentages, Ratio and Proportion, Averages, Interest (Simple and Compound), Profit and Loss,  Discount,  Mensuration, Time and Distance, Ratio and Time, Time and Work.
																
															

															 

															4. Subject Related (Driver Specific Knowledge)

															This specialized section is vital for the Constable Driver post and includes technical and regulatory knowledge:

															
																
																Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, Traffic Rules/Signals/Signages, Vehicle & Environmental Pollution (including I.e., Petrol and Diesel Vehicle, CNG operated Vehicle) Noise Pollution

															The Delhi Police Driver recruitment process includes a Written Exam (CBT) and a mandatory Trade Test.

															A. Written Exam Pattern (CBT)

															
																
																The exam is a computer-based, objective-type test consisting of a total of 100 questions for 100 marks.
																
																
																The time duration for the entire test is 90 minutes.
																
																
																There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer.
																
																
																The subject related to Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules carries the highest weightage with 50 questions (50 marks).
																
																
																General Awareness/GK and General Intelligence each contribute 20 questions (20 marks), while Numerical Ability contributes 10 questions (10 marks).
																
															

															 

															B. Trade Test Pattern

															
																
																The Trade Test is qualifying in nature and totals 125 marks; these marks do not determine the final merit position.
																
																
																Driving Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) is tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Driving Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) is also tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Knowledge of Traffic Signs/Road Sense/Basic Driving Rules is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), including topics like Lane Driving, Overtaking Procedure, and Road Map Reading.
																
																
																Knowledge of Vehicle Maintenance is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), covering practical aspects like tire pressure, battery level, oil usage, coolant, and belt/hose tension.

															Delhi Police Driver Exam Pattern 2025: Written Test & Trade Test

															The Delhi Police Driver recruitment process includes a Written Exam (CBT) and a mandatory Trade Test.

															A. Written Exam Pattern (CBT)

															
																
																The exam is a computer-based, objective-type test consisting of a total of 100 questions for 100 marks.
																
																
																The time duration for the entire test is 90 minutes.
																
																
																There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer.
																
																
																The subject related to Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules carries the highest weightage with 50 questions (50 marks).
																
																
																General Awareness/GK and General Intelligence each contribute 20 questions (20 marks), while Numerical Ability contributes 10 questions (10 marks).
																
															

															 

															B. Trade Test Pattern

															
																
																The Trade Test is qualifying in nature and totals 125 marks; these marks do not determine the final merit position.
																
																
																Driving Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) is tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Driving Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) is also tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Knowledge of Traffic Signs/Road Sense/Basic Driving Rules is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), including topics like Lane Driving, Overtaking Procedure, and Road Map Reading.
																
																
																Knowledge of Vehicle Maintenance is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), covering practical aspects like tire pressure, battery level, oil usage, coolant, and belt/hose tension.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Delhi Police Constable Driver Syllabus 2025: Exam Details and Key Topics

															Preparing for the Delhi Police Constable Driver 2025 exam? Get a competitive edge by reviewing the complete syllabus for the Computer-Based Examination. The test covers essential subjects including General Awareness/GK, General Intelligence, Numerical Ability, and a specialized section on Subject Related topics like Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules.

															 

															Key Subjects and Topics to Study:

															1. General Awareness / GK (General Knowledge)

															This section tests your knowledge of current events and significant matters related to India and its neighboring countries. Essential topics for your GK preparation include:

															
																
																Sports, History, Culture,  Geography, Indian Economy, General Polity, Indian Constitution, Scientific Research
																
															

															 

															2. General Intelligence / Reasoning

															The General Intelligence and Reasoning section evaluates your analytical aptitude and ability to identify patterns. Focus on mastering both verbal and non-verbal types of questions:

															
																
																Analogies, Similarities and Differences, Spatial Visualization, Spatial Orientation, Visual Memory, Discrimination, Observation, Relationship Concepts, Arithmetical Reasoning and Figural Classification, Arithmetic Number Series, Non-Verbal Series & Coding and Decoding
																
															

															 

															3. Numerical Ability (Quantitative Aptitude)

															This subject covers problems related to fundamental mathematical concepts. Strong preparation in these areas is crucial for scoring well:

															
																
																Number System,  Computation of Whole Numbers, Decimals and Fractions,  Relationship between Numbers, Fundamental Arithmetical Operations,  Percentages, Ratio and Proportion, Averages, Interest (Simple and Compound), Profit and Loss,  Discount,  Mensuration, Time and Distance, Ratio and Time, Time and Work.
																
															

															 

															4. Subject Related (Driver Specific Knowledge)

															This specialized section is vital for the Constable Driver post and includes technical and regulatory knowledge:

															
																
																Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, Traffic Rules/Signals/Signages, Vehicle & Environmental Pollution (including I.e., Petrol and Diesel Vehicle, CNG operated Vehicle) Noise Pollution

															Delhi Police Driver Exam Pattern 2025: Written Test & Trade Test

															The Delhi Police Driver recruitment process includes a Written Exam (CBT) and a mandatory Trade Test.

															A. Written Exam Pattern (CBT)

															
																
																The exam is a computer-based, objective-type test consisting of a total of 100 questions for 100 marks.
																
																
																The time duration for the entire test is 90 minutes.
																
																
																There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer.
																
																
																The subject related to Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules carries the highest weightage with 50 questions (50 marks).
																
																
																General Awareness/GK and General Intelligence each contribute 20 questions (20 marks), while Numerical Ability contributes 10 questions (10 marks).
																
															

															 

															B. Trade Test Pattern

															
																
																The Trade Test is qualifying in nature and totals 125 marks; these marks do not determine the final merit position.
																
																
																Driving Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) is tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Driving Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) is also tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Knowledge of Traffic Signs/Road Sense/Basic Driving Rules is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), including topics like Lane Driving, Overtaking Procedure, and Road Map Reading.
																
																
																Knowledge of Vehicle Maintenance is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), covering practical aspects like tire pressure, battery level, oil usage, coolant, and belt/hose tension.

															3. Numerical Ability (Quantitative Aptitude)

															Delhi Police Driver Exam Pattern 2025: Written Test & Trade Test

															The Delhi Police Driver recruitment process includes a Written Exam (CBT) and a mandatory Trade Test.

															A. Written Exam Pattern (CBT)

															
																
																The exam is a computer-based, objective-type test consisting of a total of 100 questions for 100 marks.
																
																
																The time duration for the entire test is 90 minutes.
																
																
																There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer.
																
																
																The subject related to Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules carries the highest weightage with 50 questions (50 marks).
																
																
																General Awareness/GK and General Intelligence each contribute 20 questions (20 marks), while Numerical Ability contributes 10 questions (10 marks).
																
															

															 

															B. Trade Test Pattern

															
																
																The Trade Test is qualifying in nature and totals 125 marks; these marks do not determine the final merit position.
																
																
																Driving Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) is tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Driving Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) is also tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Knowledge of Traffic Signs/Road Sense/Basic Driving Rules is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), including topics like Lane Driving, Overtaking Procedure, and Road Map Reading.
																
																
																Knowledge of Vehicle Maintenance is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), covering practical aspects like tire pressure, battery level, oil usage, coolant, and belt/hose tension.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Delhi Police Constable Driver Syllabus 2025: Exam Details and Key Topics

															Preparing for the Delhi Police Constable Driver 2025 exam? Get a competitive edge by reviewing the complete syllabus for the Computer-Based Examination. The test covers essential subjects including General Awareness/GK, General Intelligence, Numerical Ability, and a specialized section on Subject Related topics like Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules.

															 

															Key Subjects and Topics to Study:

															1. General Awareness / GK (General Knowledge)

															This section tests your knowledge of current events and significant matters related to India and its neighboring countries. Essential topics for your GK preparation include:

															
																
																Sports, History, Culture,  Geography, Indian Economy, General Polity, Indian Constitution, Scientific Research
																
															

															 

															2. General Intelligence / Reasoning

															The General Intelligence and Reasoning section evaluates your analytical aptitude and ability to identify patterns. Focus on mastering both verbal and non-verbal types of questions:

															
																
																Analogies, Similarities and Differences, Spatial Visualization, Spatial Orientation, Visual Memory, Discrimination, Observation, Relationship Concepts, Arithmetical Reasoning and Figural Classification, Arithmetic Number Series, Non-Verbal Series & Coding and Decoding
																
															

															 

															3. Numerical Ability (Quantitative Aptitude)

															This subject covers problems related to fundamental mathematical concepts. Strong preparation in these areas is crucial for scoring well:

															
																
																Number System,  Computation of Whole Numbers, Decimals and Fractions,  Relationship between Numbers, Fundamental Arithmetical Operations,  Percentages, Ratio and Proportion, Averages, Interest (Simple and Compound), Profit and Loss,  Discount,  Mensuration, Time and Distance, Ratio and Time, Time and Work.
																
															

															 

															4. Subject Related (Driver Specific Knowledge)

															This specialized section is vital for the Constable Driver post and includes technical and regulatory knowledge:

															
																
																Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, Traffic Rules/Signals/Signages, Vehicle & Environmental Pollution (including I.e., Petrol and Diesel Vehicle, CNG operated Vehicle) Noise Pollution

															Delhi Police Driver Exam Pattern 2025: Written Test & Trade Test

															The Delhi Police Driver recruitment process includes a Written Exam (CBT) and a mandatory Trade Test.

															A. Written Exam Pattern (CBT)

															
																
																The exam is a computer-based, objective-type test consisting of a total of 100 questions for 100 marks.
																
																
																The time duration for the entire test is 90 minutes.
																
																
																There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer.
																
																
																The subject related to Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules carries the highest weightage with 50 questions (50 marks).
																
																
																General Awareness/GK and General Intelligence each contribute 20 questions (20 marks), while Numerical Ability contributes 10 questions (10 marks).
																
															

															 

															B. Trade Test Pattern

															
																
																The Trade Test is qualifying in nature and totals 125 marks; these marks do not determine the final merit position.
																
																
																Driving Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) is tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Driving Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) is also tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Knowledge of Traffic Signs/Road Sense/Basic Driving Rules is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), including topics like Lane Driving, Overtaking Procedure, and Road Map Reading.
																
																
																Knowledge of Vehicle Maintenance is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), covering practical aspects like tire pressure, battery level, oil usage, coolant, and belt/hose tension.

															Delhi Police Driver Exam Pattern 2025: Written Test & Trade Test

															The Delhi Police Driver recruitment process includes a Written Exam (CBT) and a mandatory Trade Test.

															A. Written Exam Pattern (CBT)

															
																
																The exam is a computer-based, objective-type test consisting of a total of 100 questions for 100 marks.
																
																
																The time duration for the entire test is 90 minutes.
																
																
																There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer.
																
																
																The subject related to Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules carries the highest weightage with 50 questions (50 marks).
																
																
																General Awareness/GK and General Intelligence each contribute 20 questions (20 marks), while Numerical Ability contributes 10 questions (10 marks).
																
															

															 

															B. Trade Test Pattern

															
																
																The Trade Test is qualifying in nature and totals 125 marks; these marks do not determine the final merit position.
																
																
																Driving Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) is tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Driving Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) is also tested for 50 marks (25 qualifying), covering Driving (Forward), Driving (Backward), and Parking.
																
																
																Knowledge of Traffic Signs/Road Sense/Basic Driving Rules is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), including topics like Lane Driving, Overtaking Procedure, and Road Map Reading.
																
																
																Knowledge of Vehicle Maintenance is tested for 25 marks (12.5 qualifying), covering practical aspects like tire pressure, battery level, oil usage, coolant, and belt/hose tension.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															Delhi Police Constable Driver Syllabus 2025: Exam Details and Key Topics

															Preparing for the Delhi Police Constable Driver 2025 exam? Get a competitive edge by reviewing the complete syllabus for the Computer-Based Examination. The test covers essential subjects including General Awareness/GK, General Intelligence, Numerical Ability, and a specialized section on Subject Related topics like Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, and Traffic Rules.

															 

															Key Subjects and Topics to Study:

															1. General Awareness / GK (General Knowledge)

															This section tests your knowledge of current events and significant matters related to India and its neighboring countries. Essential topics for your GK preparation include:

															
																
																Sports, History, Culture,  Geography, Indian Economy, General Polity, Indian Constitution, Scientific Research
																
															

															 

															2. General Intelligence / Reasoning

															The General Intelligence and Reasoning section evaluates your analytical aptitude and ability to identify patterns. Focus on mastering both verbal and non-verbal types of questions:

															
																
																Analogies, Similarities and Differences, Spatial Visualization, Spatial Orientation, Visual Memory, Discrimination, Observation, Relationship Concepts, Arithmetical Reasoning and Figural Classification, Arithmetic Number Series, Non-Verbal Series & Coding and Decoding
																
															

															 

															3. Numerical Ability (Quantitative Aptitude)

															This subject covers problems related to fundamental mathematical concepts. Strong preparation in these areas is crucial for scoring well:

															
																
																Number System,  Computation of Whole Numbers, Decimals and Fractions,  Relationship between Numbers, Fundamental Arithmetical Operations,  Percentages, Ratio and Proportion, Averages, Interest (Simple and Compound), Profit and Loss,  Discount,  Mensuration, Time and Distance, Ratio and Time, Time and Work.
																
															

															 

															4. Subject Related (Driver Specific Knowledge)

															This specialized section is vital for the Constable Driver post and includes technical and regulatory knowledge:

															
																
																Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, Traffic Rules/Signals/Signages, Vehicle & Environmental Pollution (including I.e., Petrol and Diesel Vehicle, CNG operated Vehicle) Noise Pollution
